notes: Labware catalog expanded to 26 formats (added 24/384 deep-well, 96 half-area, 96 filter/membrane, 96 full-skirted PCR, PCR 8-tube strips, plus microscope slide / slide rack / coverslip). New: serial (virtual-COM) barcode scanner support on the Data Log tab - pick the scanner's COM port and Connect; its port is reserved so auto-connect never mistakes it for the display or controller. Serial scans funnel through the same handler as the built-in USB HID scanner (fill run name, start a tagged run).
